Five runs of each build, in turn. The runs of one build differ by up to 0.2 ms in the rows with 1,000 records, 1.2 ms in the rows with 20,000 records, 5.2 ms in the array row, 2.9 ms in the `Uint8Array` rows and 11 ms in the poll row. The scan reads each plain object of the pattern once, so a large pattern costs a failed call about 50 ns for each object.

mutation_line: A test build switched off 24 rules, one at a time: each rule of the scan and of the walk, and the record of the matcher that said no. 23 of them make a test fail. The barrier has none: without it the walk clears the signal that makes a call wait, and the same lines print. The barrier keeps the asks of the walk out of the journal that a call replays after a wait.
